title: Hui Pu | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set directly on the soft, sandy shores of Waialea Bay, Hui Pu is a rare beachfront sanctuary that captures the raw beauty and refined ease of island living. This exquisitely renovated A-frame Tahitian-style estate blends timeless architecture with modern design across a generous open layout. With four serene bedroom suites, reclaimed teak wood floors, and seamless indoor-outdoor spaces, the home offers a retreat where families and friends can slow down, reconnect, and soak in Hawaii’s coastal splendor. From private garden paths to shaded lanai seating and panoramic views of turquoise waters, every corner of the property invites barefoot elegance and deep relaxation. Whether gathered in the main house under vaulted ceilings or tucked into the tranquil Ohana cottage with its ocean-view office, guests experience privacy, comfort, and endless inspiration. Spend your days snorkeling in the bay’s crystalline coves, strolling the nearby King’s Trail to Hapuna Beach, or savoring sunsets from the upper lanai. Surrounded by lush landscaping and set within a private gated enclave, Hui Pu is a beachside haven where whale songs drift on the breeze and the spirit of aloha lives in every detail. This is where memory and magic meet.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 2: Two Single Over Single Bunks + Queen
